title: Finish retiring SNS, and document it
description:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** Removes what kanbus-78f229 lists outside Papyrus. Each AWS account then has only its own two last-resort alerts, plus any machine-only topic Ryan accepted. Ends with the p.apyr.us docs, as the epic says.

**Acceptance.**
A check per account lists only the two last-resort alarms on human topics.

**Depends on:** kanbus-78f229, kanbus-49f7bd, kanbus-ecbda3
**Related:** PPY-f66e91, PPY-819117
